question: After the move the code no longer reads legacy_limits, but it holds 14 000 rows of limit history (2019–2024) and the test bench has no database backup. Should the migration delete the table or keep it?

options.label: Keep the table (Recommended)
options.description: The migration adds only the line '-- legacy_limits kept'. All 14 000 history rows stay, and you can still drop the table later.

options.label: Delete the table
options.description: The migration runs DROP TABLE legacy_limits. The 14 000 history rows are gone for good, and the test bench has no backup to restore them.
